- link "Skip to content":
  - /url: "#main"
- banner:
  - link "Real2Simulation":
    - /url: /
  - navigation "Main navigation":
    - link "Demo library":
      - /url: /library
    - link "Local simulation lab":
      - /url: /lab
    - link "Sign in":
      - /url: /sign-in
- main:
  - region "Test a motion model":
    - paragraph: Synthetic lab · Mystery-g
    - heading "Test a motion model" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Explore a deterministic, simulated trajectory before connecting a measured video.
    - group "Template":
      - generic: Template
      - radio "Free fall Ballistic drop" [checked]
      - strong: Free fall
      - generic: Ballistic drop
      - radio "Projectile Ballistic launch"
      - strong: Projectile
      - generic: Ballistic launch
      - radio "Ramp Sliding motion"
      - strong: Ramp
      - generic: Sliding motion
      - radio "Pendulum Oscillation"
      - strong: Pendulum
      - generic: Oscillation
    - checkbox "Mystery-g mode Hide the simulated gravity until reveal"
    - strong: Mystery-g mode
    - generic: Hide the simulated gravity until reveal
    - button "Run trial"
    - button "Fit & reveal"
    - status: Fit complete. This is simulated evidence, not a calibrated measurement.
    - generic "Synthetic trial results":
      - paragraph: Observed trajectory
      - heading "Free fall samples" [level=2]
      - generic: Simulated · m
      - paragraph: Downward vertical displacement from start (positive down), not distance along the ramp or pendulum arc. The chart uses all finite observations; the table is sampled.
      - img "Simulated downward vertical displacement from start over time in s and m":
        - generic: time (s)
        - generic: downward displacement (m)
      - table "Sampled observations":
        - caption: Sampled observations
        - rowgroup:
          - row "Time (s) Downward displacement (m)":
            - columnheader "Time (s)"
            - columnheader "Downward displacement (m)"
        - rowgroup:
          - row "0.00 0.000":
            - cell "0.00"
            - cell "0.000"
          - row "0.03 0.003":
            - cell "0.03"
            - cell "0.003"
          - row "0.05 0.013":
            - cell "0.05"
            - cell "0.013"
          - row "0.08 0.030":
            - cell "0.08"
            - cell "0.030"
          - row "0.10 0.053":
            - cell "0.10"
            - cell "0.053"
          - row "0.13 0.083":
            - cell "0.13"
            - cell "0.083"
          - row "0.16 0.119":
            - cell "0.16"
            - cell "0.119"
          - row "0.18 0.162":
            - cell "0.18"
            - cell "0.162"
          - row "0.20 0.196":
            - cell "0.20"
            - cell "0.196"
      - paragraph: Reveal
      - heading "9.810 ± 0.0000737 m/s^2" [level=2]
      - paragraph: "Gravity · source: simulated"
      - paragraph: Uncertainty is one standard uncertainty (1σ), not a 95% interval.
      - paragraph: "Uncertainty model: independent_position_time_first_order. independent observation errors first-order timing linearization at fitted velocity per-observation variance max(RSS/dof, position_sigma^2 + velocity^2*time_sigma^2) scale fixed no correlated clock-rate or scale uncertainty no calibration of declared standard uncertainties no errors-in-variables bias correction"
      - region "In-browser simulation":
        - heading "In-browser trajectory" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Simulated · synthetic · RK4-only. No contact response or free drag.
        - button "Compute in browser"
        - status: NORMAL mode only. Compute to show the actual engine trace.
      - paragraph:
        - strong: "Limits:"
        - text: synthetic authored instrument settings first-order independent timing/position uncertainty; no correlated clock-rate or scale uncertainty; not calibrated
- contentinfo: Development build. Synthetic lab results are not calibrated measurements. No uploads are enabled.
- button "Open Next.js Dev Tools":
- alert
